notes.title: Steamdeck compatibility update + minor fixes
notes.notes:
This new patch [i]attempts[/i] to enhance Steam deck compatibility for the game. The game should now start with gamepad controls enabled for Steam deck users, initialize at 1280x720 resolution, and UI scaling has been fixed for a few problematic screens when using Steam deck resolutions. 

Other minor fixes include a few spelling errors and a permanent buff in the Butlery not activating properly. 


As always, if you enjoy the game I would really appreciate you thinking about leaving a review so others can find it too! 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.notes:
Monsters of Mican: Crystal Edition is nearing full release! 

But until then, the demo has been updated with many of the features coming soon!

The demo itself still only contains three dungeon levels, Albright Outpost (the town map) and the Monster Arena. But now it has additional features:


[list]
[*]Fishing- what is an RPG without fishing? Pick up the fishing rod lying around against a rock on the beach and get casting in any body of water! A new NPC named Herman the Crab Hermit will give you a quest to find all 12 types of fish in the world, but be warned that fishing too much in one spot can draw the attention of fearsome sea beasts....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/97284d94c6a3d90dc1ed23ed1e8b26e2ca2824c1.png[/img]

[*]80 new monsters! From Gemignite to Carewolf to Challahback, enemy variety has never been better! Now there are nearly 300 monster types to fight, befriend, and chat with! And with 4 different Monster Buddy interactions for each monster that's... A lot of dialogue!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/8c07bdd64140fcae89d844e417eb15a25d3ea603.gif[/img]

[*]Game saves now include a screenshot of where you last saved! Not as major as the others, but still very neat and welcome in my opinion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/451dd7c7e8a52f8be44bfdd48c766e8c4305f003.png[/img]

[*]New renovations! Many areas have been completely renovated, given new and better lighting, more interesting clutter and architecture, and some extra secrets!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/d1d6e7d8f434893f908ec8a3ed971c2c86063e93.png[/img]

[*]Monster Arena- a new door on the combat level leads to the locker room and showers! Talk with the monsters as they prepare for their fights, and maybe find a few secrets and even a minor quest! 

[*]Monster Glade- the Monsters decided to make it more homey! You'll find a number of different decorative areas for monsters to vibe in, and possibly a secret or two for those sharp eyed (or bouncy legged)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/1a04363b9b43acb8de699c98b0826536eb41306b.png[/img]

[*]Quality of Life updates-

- Added a "bulk sell" button in shops, which lets you sell all equipment of any single rarity (common, magic, epic, etc). Helpful to cut down on scrolling through your inventory! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/9b45d2fa34a791fc568394f72bf7fe331604e832.png[/img]

- Added a "Level to cap" button at the trainer! Now instead of clicking 50 times to gain 50 levels, you can click just once to train to your current cap (whether capped by gold or experience)! A real time saver! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/344f86eab15bf30af504ca67173597b5cd3141ae.png[/img]

- Added a "Handy Heal All" button in the overview section of the pause menu. This can only be used outside of battle, but using it will have your healer(s) heal the party to full instantly if possible. Useful if you don't want to rest and lose your current buffs!

[*]Other changes: 

- Game performance has been significantly upgraded on all maps due to removing redundant and deprecated functions, as well as other optimizations
- Added monster viewer to the main menu
- Added new songs to the main menu music room 

[/list]

notes.title: Minor controls fix (2/28/2025)
notes.notes:
Fixed a minor issue with left and right arrow keys being unmappable due to being used for turning in top-down mode.

Added default key bindings to the up, down, left and right arrows to mimic WSAD keys too, so those no longer need to be set in the key config menu. 



Also, I am in the process of updating how the typewriter text effect works, so it should run a bit smoother (i.e. during conversations with NPCs). In the future the text will include emphasis styling as and inline images as well.

notes.title: January '25 update: New monsters, new potions, new traits, who dis
notes.notes:
[h2]This update was mainly started to address two issues- the Etherealize spell was buggy when resting, so it has now been fixed, and I was asked to add support for ultra widescreen and super ultra widescreen. While the UI does not change, both of those aspect ratios are now supported for the game camera. 

Also my kid drew some monsters and I made them ːsteamhappyː[/h2]

[h3]Full (mostly) changes below:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug with Etherealize and resting

[*] Added support for ultrawide and super ultrawide resolutions

[*] Heal/Group Heal now additionally heal for a small percentage of the recipient's max HP

[*] Using abilities outside of combat no longer switches to the next character (useful for spamming heal)

[*] Added Toothbrush Fairy monster
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/620f7cda31862c6492ba34a8b44a416ce769d1bc.png[/img]

[*] Added Cake Grump monster
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/81691136278f763682f964fbbd8b9ba61fe53e55.png[/img]

[*] Added Hoodlumure monster
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/a9ea0e6e3bb8de33bc2992b120ca4fc412caa1e6.png[/img]

[*] Changed how some monster traits and buffs work

[*] Changed how the enemy detail box works- right clicking/right stick press now toggles the box and allows the user to hover over each trait or buff. Moving the mouse outside of the box or clicking will remove the box (On gamepad pressing the right face button or right stick again will close the box)

[*] Added Dualstriker trait: Character strikes twice each attack

[*] Added Freshener trait: Character's attacks have a chance to remove poison/disease from target

[*] Added Adorable trait: Character who kills a monster with Adorable gains the Depression debuff

[*] Added Angry trait: +2% attack damage per stack

[*] Added Juggernaut trait: Character gains 5 attack buffs (+10% att each) each turn spent moving without attacking, loses all buffs after attacking

[*] Added Ranged Mass Attack trait: Character can randomly choose to do a ranged attack to all available targets, with a longer recovery time

[*] Rebalanced many enemy traits (i.e., added many traits to enemies)

[*] Added Calm ability
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/b08b801e311999cd9ed5dbb92663588ef630a211.png[/img]

[*] Added Chosen One ability
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/849fd97718ec70f1d8c3a957d4480b123fc5c3e5.png[/img]

[*] Added Revive potions, and small chance to find potions in enemy loot drops

[*] Rebalanced potion levels, added new potions

[*] Added randomized (and non-randomized) potions to chests throughout the world

[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Free Expansion One is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/3736d513906f6e3aecaded15b31f7976c40da77e.png[/img]

Introducing Monsters of Mican: Vitreous Expansion.* 

Featuring three brand new dungeons, all accessible from Albright Outpost:

[list]
Spinewood Forest - home to the Fairy Queen Bryxialla, this dungeon teems with traps and creatures that want nothing more than to put you in the ground to fertilize the soil. Beware the many illusions and foggy spots in the forest, lest you lose your way...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/7f55981a879b3d7e58174c3f871dbfa96e32e69d.png[/img]

The Pipeline- brave the stench as you trudge through toxic muck to receive the unique bounty offered by the denizens of the sewer. Prepare to go for a swim as you fight the mighty Dungen Master and proceed to Lord Muffin's lair...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/648f1747dc92ef55260bf8ee93d9e5d24f6a08ca.png[/img]

The Butlery- a magically interconnected space meant for storing and processing food served to all inns throughout the world who belong to the Tavern Association. The inner workings of the Butlery though are not for the faint of heart, as you must brave four unique and discrete zones before gaining access to the most prized innkeeper's items within the Vault. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/bdd19c5ba22604a450f25bfbc01a8d1c7e0598c0.png[/img]
[/list]

The expansion includes many, many other new features including:


[list]
80+ new monsters, bringing the total to over 250!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/0180e9a2907eff75f146121cb4086d4b03f41749.png[/img]

A Monster Arena, where you can bet on matches or design your own custom monster fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/06dd805ae39cb8e0a9c38dd18e8dcfe757b7c21b.png[/img]

Retooled difficulty balance! You must now seek out skill tomes before you are able to train a skill up to master, grandmaster or legend ranks! Normal/hard difficulty introduces new traps throughout all of the dungeons! Monsters (especially Elites) can get new traits based on your chosen difficulty!

The Micapedia! A new interactive 3D Monster viewer that lets you inspect the model of any monster you've defeated, and view all of its combat animations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/182253b310829fec59147fcc397c7249d97fb806.png[/img]

A top-down toggle! For those who don't love first person perspectives, a more classic "top down" mode can be toggled by just a press of the "v" key! Turn 90 degrees with the on-screen arrow buttons or the left/right arrow keys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/1a6840c6efdb766f9e212745bf9ec9456d9b2a1f.png[/img]

New spells/abilities, new gear, new traits, new enchantments!

Various bug fixes and visual improvements!

[/list]

Adventuring in Mican has never been better!







*You may be wondering about the name. Well, the original (single) expansion was going to be called the "Crystal Expansion" because of a new crystal themed dungeon in the works, but it got bigger than expected and now that dungeon will have to wait a bit more. And things need to vitrify before they become crystals...

notes.title: 10/15/2024 Update
notes.notes:
This update [i]should[/i] finally fix the bug with temporary stat/skill changes not wearing off properly. Please let me know if it somehow persists, but I did identify the issue which caused it, which relied on a very particular set of circumstances making it a very rare occurrence.

Other minor fixes-

- Several minor typos
- Fixed an issue with conversation/quest data not being saved properly 
- Fixed an issue where trap triggers on the third dungeon floor did not fire properly

notes.title: Minor update 10/12/24
notes.notes: This update fixes the Reset Stats function at the cheat vendor (.devfix.resetstats is the code for it), and also fixes a minor issue with the Unleash ability where sometimes the monster buddy wouldn't load correctly.

notes.title: 10/11/2024 Patch- Another go at fixing stat/skill issues
notes.notes:
This update shouldn't change much, despite the size. It mainly addresses the still rare issue of stat/skill/resistance bonuses or penalties not wearing off correctly, and also hopefully fixes the dev fix function at the cheat vendor in town (usable by typing in ".devfix.resetstats" into the cheat window).

Additionally, this update adds much more detail to the combat log when an effect wears off. You'll notice this in combat of course but it can also be seen outside of combat by opening the log in the notes menu. The purpose of this is to help me narrow down why exactly this stat/skill/resistance bug happens, if it happens again, so if anybody does experience an issue where those values are much, much lower or higher than they should be (even after considering equipment bonuses) please let me know in as much detail as you can what may have happened.

I apologize that this issue seems to be persisting, and thank you for playing!

notes.title: Minor update- Map save fix
notes.notes:
This update [i]should[/i] finally fix the issue with maps sometimes not loading the fully explored area when loading from file.

[b]Important:[/b] saves made before this patch will likely still have missing map reveal progress upon loading, at least for some of the levels. But any saves made after should work correctly when loaded from file. I apologize for the issue.

notes.title: Minor fixes, additional debug "cheat code"
notes.notes:
Hi all, this patch is mostly due to the reports of temporary effects (i.e. buffs/debuffs from status conditions) being reported to stay on a character permanently. As this is clearly unintended, I've tried multiple times to add more safeguards to prevent it from happening. I've never been able to recreate the issue myself, but hopefully some more of the safeguards I just added will help- I did identify a few areas where an error could happen and patched those up, so hopefully you won't see these bugs again.

However, if you have experienced this issue there is now a solution- the cheat vendor "Mister Sweets" now has a new cheat, activated by inputting ".devfix.ResetStats" (with both periods but no quotes). This [i]should[/i] remove all temporary effects and conditions (not including unconsciousness/death/vaporization) and revert each characters' stat mods back to zero. After doing this you'll still likely see stat mods when hovering over the numbers- these are from your currently equipped items. 

Additional changes are mostly minor fixes, collision tweaks, a few minor balance changes and a few new traits and enchantments that likely won't show up yet as they're mainly being prepared for the incoming final content update. Which should launch before the end of September!

notes.title: Added update to game over screen
notes.notes:
The game over screen had fallen through the cracks in the UI update. It has now been updated as well to match the rest of the UI.

Hopefully you won't see it much!

notes.title: Major UI Overhaul
notes.notes:
It's been a while!

The vast majority of the game's UI elements have now been significantly upgraded. Changes include:

- Most text UI elements now have a scroll backing, including the status bar, the interaction window, conversation boxes, notice windows and more
- Decorative buttons! Almost every button has now been unified to one decorative button type. 
- Button color gems. In the interaction window, these gems will now replace the previous icons that would show up when using the Precognition ability. Green = good, red = bad, yellow = mixed. 
- Character portraits have been significantly changed. Character portraits now include colored crystal indicators showing which character is active (green), which characters are available (white) and which characters are killed (black) or otherwise unavailable [i.e. stunned or unconscious] (red).
- Character name scrolls- the portraits also include scrolls containing the character's name.
- Individual active effect icons- below the portraits is now a bar that will show icons of currently active individual effects, including Defend, Barrier, Blood Frenzy, Magic Mirror, Smokescreen and Protector. 

Other changes:

- A short text introduction before the prologue starts
- Added several new enemy traits, including Weakener, Defiant and Mass Attacker.
- Fixed a few audio glitches in the Mutono boss level.
- Fixed a few other minor bugs and typos

notes.title: Minor stability update
notes.notes:
An issue has been brought to my attention seemingly revolving around the steam overlay being enabled. I'm having trouble completely replicating it, but this update should hopefully help prevent it from occuring.

Still, I would recommend avoiding opening the steam overlay often, and saving before doing so. If something does get corrupted exiting the game and loading that save will fix it. 

Part of this effort sees the "select previous character" function mapped to ctrl+tab now, rather than shift+tab as it was before. 

Thanks again for playing!

notes.title: Big changes to Albright Outpost!
notes.notes:
New locations have been discovered in Albright Outpost! In anticipation of the upcoming final content update, the Development Gnomes have prepared new areas of the outdoors to explore. Including a mysterious abandoned house with a tightly locked door. What secrets could it hold? And a new NPC to have a short conversation with. 

In addition to all of this, this update fixes a few more minor bugs and enhances the UI:

- Fixed exploit with character creator not resetting pool points when changing class
- Fixed UI scaling issues in conversations
- Fixed equipment stat comparison
- Added the ability to buy the selected spell in the magic shop with the space button
- Fixed issue that could occur with levers not having their states saved correctly upon saving game
- Several other minor UI tweaks


Hope you enjoy the new update, and look forward to the big content update coming soon!

notes.title: Major Update- New Prologue/tutorial and HUD
notes.notes:
This is not THE big one, but nevertheless a big one. The big new features here:

- Prologue. Accessible from the main menu when you start a new game, you can now play through the short prologue to get a feel for various gameplay elements before being prompted to create your party. This should be extremely helpful for newcomers who tend to get stuck on character creation.

- New HUD. Inspired by several requests for more HUD features, the main-game HUD now has two new elements

              - the upper menu icon bar. This tells you which keyboard keys take you to which menu sections (oh yeah, that's also new), as well as introduces the "Flee" key, only usable in combat of course. 

              - the right-hand Buff Bar, which now conveniently shows you which party buffs are currently active. A handy way to realize what you may be missing. 

              - Also, the ability in the Options menu to change HUD style if you don't like this new one. Either to Buff-Bar only or classic/light. HUD opacity can still be changed in the video options. 



Some other minor changes/fixes:

- Added quickload function. F9 (the default key) will now load the most recent quicksave instantly.
- Changed how Prepare Weapons/Armor works: Prepare Weapons now comes with a base additional damage bonus on top of the multiplier bonus. As a result use in early levels should see better results before it evens out at higher levels. 
           - Fixed error with the Prepare Weapons/Armor icons staying on the party buffs page- these buffs are now removed after every combat encounter as explained in the description
-Fixed minor issue with some chests not saving state
-Fixed missing gold cost for Solar Fusion (sorry)
-Fixed recently introduced bug that prevents characters from learning spells from scrolls

notes.title: Minor additional update
notes.notes:
I wasn't sure I'd get to this today, but I managed to. 

This update does two things- 

- Increases availability of healing/mana potions at the general store. Higher character levels mean the store will have stronger potions available.

- Adds indicators to the character icons in the pause menu which will let you know if the character is ready to level up, and if the character has enough unspent skill points to raise a skill level.

notes.title: Major UI overhaul, Fixed equip from inventory bug
notes.notes:
Hi all, been a while!

This update is pretty big, and the changed listed here are not exhaustive. Many of the assets have received a bit of an overhaul, including some of the walls/floors and even some enemies (particularly ones with skulls). But more noticeable is a major UI update, now with proper borders!

On top of that this update fixes the equip from inventory bug I noted previously, as well as a minor math issue for calculating monster speed boosts. 

Also, examining monsters (via right click/right stick press) now gives you a lot more info about their current speed/recovery and buff status.

notes.title: Equipment bug found, fix is pending.
notes.notes:
EDIT: The problem has been fixed. 

It's been brought to my attention that equipping items from the inventory menu (via the equip button) can sometimes cause the currently equipped item in that spot to be lost. This will be fixed in the next update, but I cannot guarantee that will be out soon, so for now do not use that equip button from the inventory menu for a character that already has an item in that slot.

To repeat, the avoid this bug [b] do not use the "equip" button in the inventory menu to equip an item into a slot which already has an item[/b]

Thanks as always for playing, and I apologize for the bug!

notes.title: Minor update 4/13/2024 (my birthday)
notes.notes:
Happy birthday me, woo!

Anyway, this one is a minor update:

- Fixed issue with the Transfigure Equipment spell. It should now work properly both in and out of battle
- Fixed various minor UI issues
- Fixed issues with XP values getting too long for the screen- they have now been condensed after the value exceeds 10,000 or 10,000,000 to have a k or a M after the value.
- Minor typo corrections

notes.title: 4/11/2024 Update
notes.notes:
Inflation has hit Mican! Learning a new skill now costs 2000 gold, this was done to prevent players from being overwhelmed with skill choices early on. Other changes:

- Put a lower limit on recovery rate: recovery rate can no longer go below 10. Hover over the displayed rate in the character screen to see the true recovery rate value
- Added a "recovery time" indicator to the progress bar on each character's portrait. This tells you how much time (in ambiguous time units, not seconds) you still need to recover for a new action
- Changed the recovery time for defending from 50 to 30, this lets you recover more quickly if you simply defend. 
- Added a red skull indicator to the top of the MP bar if your MP exceeds the max. If you see the red skull there, using magic will damage you heavily!

- Fixed minor issue with lava field ability

notes.title: Added option to invert Y axis
notes.notes:
The option is available in the options menu.

Also fixed a minor issue with the video options menu.

notes.title: Emergency Fix
notes.notes: There was a high level enemy left at the start of the first dungeon floor, it has now been removed. I apologize for the inconvenience!

notes.title: New Monsters! And new ability bar manager
notes.notes:
This update introduces 4 new monster types:

- The Jarl
- Lost Sole
- Cheese Wiz
- Muffin Man

They will spawn throughout the game in appropriate locations for their levels. And of course in the Monster Rush zone. 


Also as requested I have added a new menu feature in the abilities screen- an ability bar manager. It allows the user to slot in abilities far more easily, or clear already assigned abilities.

-Fixed a minor issue with selecting the next character while using the quick spell menu, this should no longer be possible

notes.title: 4/8/2024 Update: Merchant and Burglary skill improvements
notes.notes:
This update primarily focuses on the Merchant and Burglary skills, which previously had inaccurate descriptions.

-Burglary Master: you now have a chance to steal an item from an enemy on a standard attack
-Burglary Legend: at the legend rank all enemies will drop extra gold (2x the normal amount) and may drop a second item, depending on your luck

-Merchant: Fixed the price calculation on buying and selling. The max discount is now 75%, and the maximum selling price increase is 175%. 
-Merchant Abilities: Added two brand new abilities for the Merchant skill- Toss Gold and Make It Rain. Both abilities cause enemies to become confused with a high reliability
-Merchant Grandmaster: all shops will have more basic items and special items to sell at a time
-Merchant Legend: you now have a 50% chance of receiving a free item when buying any item, the free item being of up to 2x the quality of the one you bought

Other changes:

-Fixed minor UI issues
-Changed quickspell menu to not pause the game music
-Changed enemies to stop wandering when player movement is paused

notes.title: 4/6/2024 minor update
notes.notes:
-Added indicators in the overview screen and character screen detailing how much XP is needed until the next level

-Fixed a bug where the mob resetting lion would activate any time you reenter town after using it

notes.title: 4/5/2024 Patch
notes.notes: -Fixed save bug where a "create new save" button would not appear in the full save menu if a save hadn't been previously created (through autosave/quicksave)

notes.title: 4/4/2024 Polish update and minor fixes
notes.notes:
Added a few new functions to help make for a smoother experience.

-Added a "move back" function for enemies who get too close (i.e. in the camera view)
-Added a few more safeguards to prevent enemy turns from overlapping
-Changed a few UI elements to be more uniform and look a bit nicer
-Changed the starting tutorial to be clearer and more effective
-Added an option to see the tutorial again when interacting with Jeppel

-Fixed issues with gamepad use in options/video menu
-Fixed a few late-game achievement bugs
-Fixed issue with party wipe-out from stoning preventing recovery from stoning
-Fixed issue with town portal after being the game

As always, thanks for playing and please share any other issues you may come across!

notes.title: April Fool's update
notes.notes:
Jesters aren't always the best class to have in your party... but for a short time each year they are blessed by the heavens, and make a valuable contribution to any party!

(From now on, for the first week of April any year all Jesters will have boosted attack, defense, and Crack Wise will be much more effective)

notes.title: 3/30/2024 Update: Fixed gold overflow
notes.notes:
- Fixed gold overflow bug: previously after exceeding the engine limit for the gold integer (over 2 billion) the gold would then become negative. This will no longer occur.

- Added a gold dev fix to the cheat vendor- if something does cause the gold to go negative input the code ".DEVFIX.GOLD" to the cheat vendor in town to switch it back to a positive value.

- Fixed minor issues in a late game boss encounter.

- Added a few new artifacts and cheat codes

notes.title: 3/29/2024 Update
notes.notes:
-Fixed various minor bugs
    - Fixed skill point dialogue after leveling up
    - Disabled autosave from occurring in the main menu when starting a new game
    - Fixed minor UI issues

- Added a keyboard configuration readout, which lists each input key in the game, not just the ones that can be changed

- Fixed keyboard remapping feature to save configuration when saving a game. This will likely cause your keyboard configuration to revert to default after downloading this update, but all subsequent saves should contain the correct input configuration.

notes.title: New Keyboard feature
notes.notes:
As requested, the F1-F4 keys can now be used to select your characters directly. This can be done in menu and during gameplay, but will not work during battle for obvious reasons.

Additionally, enemy pathfinding has been upgraded to be more stable. Enemy hit timing should also be improved.

A few minor bugs have also been fixed. 

Thanks as always for playing!

notes.title: Minor polish patch
notes.notes: Several monsters' attack timings were slightly off so they've been fixed for a smoother user experience.

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.notes:
-Magic Missile previously froze the game if no enemies were in view, this has now been fixed

-Kraken Puppae during Draken fight could sometimes spawn incorrectly and remain within the level bounds, this has now been fixed

notes.title: XP glitch
notes.notes: There was an odd XP glitch where XP would occasionally not be added after battle, it has now been fixed.

notes.title: Keymapping fix patch corrected
notes.notes: The update should now be functional.

notes.title: Returned to previous build
notes.notes: Returned to previous build, major startup error found in the last one.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix (plus bonus monster)
notes.notes:
This update fixes a couple of minor issues with the key remapping menu. Namely, it fees up the left and right arrow keys to be used for moving left and right, and fixes an issue with mapping "backwards" movement to the S key.


Additionally, there should be a new monster type called a Poultrygeist in the game. It can spawn randomly at any spawn point that contains its monster level. Bawk bawk!
